results.title: Marina City Council Amends Short-Term Rental Ordinance to Address Legal Concerns
results.description: The Marina City Council has amended its short-term rental ordinance to align with state law and address the issue of accessory dwelling unit availability for low-income families. The ordinance now restricts houses with accessory dwelling units built after January 1, 2020, from obtaining short-term rental permits. The council also amended definitions related to ownership and occupancy to ensure the units are used by residents with a genuine connection to the property.
